rows.name: New Hampshire Fish and Game Commission
rows.mandate: Sets policy for New Hampshire's fish and wildlife. Eleven members appointed by the Governor with Executive Council consent, one from each county and tidewater (RSA 206:2).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the New Hampshire Revised Statutes; NH publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: New Hampshire Real Estate Commission
rows.constituent: New Hampshire home buyers & licensed brokers
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates New Hampshire's real estate brokers and salespersons. Five members appointed by the Governor with Executive Council consent — two brokers, a salesperson, a lawyer, and a public member (RSA 331-A:5).
